record.paper_title: THE LYAPIN’S NOTEBOOK: A COLLECTION OF UNSOLVED PROBLEMS IN SEMIGROUP THEORY
record.original_question: Determine whether there is an algorithm that decides, for a given finite semigroup, whether it embeds into a power semigroup over some finite group, or more generally over some periodic group.

evidence.quote:
Problem 1.3. (S. Bershadsky, S. Kublanovsky) Is there an algorithm that decides whether a given
finite semigroup is embeddable into a power semigroup over some finite group (periodic group) (see
Chapter 5 of this notebook)?
             Not every finite semigroup has this property, but every semigroup is a divisor of the power
semigroup over a periodic group (see [1]). For divisors of power semigroups over finite groups the
answer is positive (see [3]).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a group (or more generally a semigroup) $G$, the power semigroup $\mathcal{P}(G)$ is the semigroup whose underlying set is the collection of all nonempty subsets of $G$, equipped with the multiplication
$$A\cdot B=\{ab:a\in A,\ b\in B\}$$
for $A,B\subseteq G$ nonempty. A group is called periodic if every element has finite order. A semigroup $S$ is said to embed into a semigroup $T$ if there is an injective homomorphism $S\hookrightarrow T$.

It is known that not every finite semigroup embeds into a power semigroup over some finite group, although every semigroup is a divisor (a homomorphic image of a subsemigroup) of the power semigroup over some periodic group, and the property of being a divisor of the power semigroup of some finite group is algorithmically decidable for finite semigroups.

Question: Does there exist an algorithm which, given as input a finite semigroup $S$ (e.g., by its multiplication table), decides whether $S$ embeds into the power semigroup $\mathcal{P}(G)$ for some finite group $G$? More generally, does there exist such an algorithm deciding whether $S$ embeds into $\mathcal{P}(G)$ for some periodic group $G$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is listed in a recent (2026) compilation of unsolved problems in semigroup theory continuing Lyapin's notebook, attributed to S. Bershadsky and S. Kublanovsky. No published resolution was found; the related question of being a divisor of the power semigroup of a finite group is known to be decidable, but the embeddability decision problem appears to remain open.
